steps.text: Heat the oven to 200C fan. Season the breasts all over with the salt and pepper.
Sear them skin side down in the oil in an ovenproof pan, without moving them.
Turn them, add the butter, and put the pan straight into the oven.
Squeeze half the lemon over and spoon the pan juices across the top.
Leave them on a board for five minutes so the juices settle back in.
Slice them thickly and serve with the rest of the lemon.
